--- a/.claude/scripts/check-loa.sh
+++ b/.claude/scripts/check-loa.sh
@@ -44,28 +44,47 @@ check_mounted() {
   log "Loa mounted: v$(jq -r '.framework_version' "$VERSION_FILE")"
 }
 
+# cycle-130 FR-1 (#1267; SDD §5.3): three outcomes per manifest path.
+#   present, hash matches            -> ok
+#   present, hash differs            -> Tampered (fail)
+#   absent, submodule mount detected (.loa/.claude is a directory) and the
+#     path exists under .loa/<path>   -> not-mounted (counted, one summary
+#     line, informational: never changes the exit code; the mount links a
+#     subset of the upstream tree by design)
+#   absent otherwise                 -> Missing (fail)
+# The manifest is read once (path<TAB>hash) instead of one jq call per path.
 check_integrity() {
   echo "Checking System Zone integrity (sha256)..."
   [[ -f "$CHECKSUMS_FILE" ]] || { warn "No checksums file - skipping integrity check"; return; }
 
   local drift=false
-  while IFS= read -r file; do
-    local expected=$(jq -r --arg f "$file" '.files[$f]' "$CHECKSUMS_FILE")
-    [[ -z "$expected" || "$expected" == "null" ]] && continue
+  local submodule_mount=false
+  local not_mounted=0
+  local file expected actual
+  [[ -d ".loa/.claude" ]] && submodule_mount=true
+
+  while IFS=$'\t' read -r file expected; do
+    [[ -z "$file" || -z "$expected" || "$expected" == "null" ]] && continue
 
     if [[ -f "$file" ]]; then
-      local actual=$(sha256_portable "$file" | cut -d' ' -f1)
+      actual=$(sha256_portable "$file" | cut -d' ' -f1)
       if [[ "$expected" != "$actual" ]]; then
         fail "Tampered: $file"
         drift=true
       fi
+    elif [[ "$submodule_mount" == "true" && -f ".loa/${file}" ]]; then
+      not_mounted=$((not_mounted + 1))
     else
       fail "Missing: $file"
       drift=true
     fi
-  done < <(jq -r '.files | keys[]' "$CHECKSUMS_FILE")
+  done < <(jq -r '.files | to_entries[] | "\(.key)\t\(.value)"' "$CHECKSUMS_FILE")
 
+  if [[ $not_mounted -gt 0 ]]; then
+    log "not-mounted: ${not_mounted} path(s) exist in the upstream tree but are not linked by this mount"
+  fi
   [[ "$drift" == "false" ]] && log "Integrity verified"
+  return 0
 }

1	# Dockerfile.ablation — container executor image for the cycle-130 component ablation
     2	# (SDD D-4.9 / DEC-0411). Extends Dockerfile.sandbox's pinned base and non-root user
     3	# with the Claude Code CLI, the codex CLI, pytest and bats. It holds NO credentials.
     4	# pipeline-run.sh mounts exactly two host paths: the sandbox read-write at /workspace
     5	# and a per-run writable HOME at /home/evaluser (<run>/meta/home: the codex CLI's
     6	# auth.json/config.toml copies, empty .claude/ and .aws/; the CLI's session store). The
     7	# Bedrock route authenticates from AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK passed in the environment.
     8	# The image's tool versions (below) are the batch's versions: every arm runs here.
     9	#
    10	# Build (no build context is needed; nothing is COPY'd):
    11	#   docker build -t loa-ablation:258 - < evals/harness/Dockerfile.ablation
    12	# Run:
    13	#   evals/harness/pipeline-run.sh --executor container --image loa-ablation:258 …
    14	#   (pipeline-run.sh passes --rm --name --user --network bridge --read-only --tmpfs /tmp
    15	#    --pids-limit 512 --memory 4g --cpus 2 and exactly the two mounts)
    16	#
    17	# Digest pinned 2026-02-11 (same base as Dockerfile.sandbox):
    18	#   docker manifest inspect node:20.11.0-bookworm-slim | jq '.manifests[0].digest'
    19	FROM rust:1-bookworm AS brbuild
    20	RUN cargo install beads_rust --version 0.2.6 --root /opt/br --locked 2>/dev/null || cargo install beads_rust --version 0.2.6 --root /opt/br
    21

    23

    35	    python3-venv \
    36	    grep \
    37	    diffutils \
    38	    coreutils \
    39	    procps \

    44	# yq (mikefarah/yq) with SHA256 integrity verification (as Dockerfile.sandbox)
    45	ARG YQ_VERSION=v4.40.5
    46	ARG YQ_SHA256_AMD64=0d6aaf1cf44a8d18fbc7ed0ef14f735a8df8d2e314c4cc0f0242d35c0a440c95
    47	ARG YQ_SHA256_ARM64=9431f0fa39a0af03a152d7fe19a86e42e9ff28d503ed4a70598f9261ec944a97
    48	RUN arch=$(dpkg --print-architecture) && \

   100	    bats --version && claude --version && codex --version && \
   101	    echo "All tools verified"
   102

     1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# ablation-row.sh — one runs.jsonl row per ablation run (cycle-130 FR-6, SDD §3.1, §5.8)
     4	#
     5	# Joins a run directory's meta/pipeline.json (pipeline-run.sh), its eval/ MODELINV
     6	# and cost ledgers, the dissent envelopes under
     7	# sandbox/grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/adversarial-{review,audit}.json, the
     8	# transcripts' tool inputs, grade.json (Sprint 259's grader; optional) and the batch
     9	# MANIFEST.json (optional) into one SDD §3.1 row, or validates a runs.jsonl file.
    10	#
    11	# The arm comes from the batch manifest's `arm_map[run_id]`, else from meta/arm,
    12	# else from meta/pipeline.json — never from sandbox/ (DEC-0413). A manifest arm that
    13	# disagrees with meta/arm is refused (exit 2).
    14	#
    15	# Derived fields:
    16	#   status          pipeline status (completed | agent_error | cap_failure | interrupted |
    17	#                   infrastructure_error; a `running` record — driver killed — reads
    18	#                   interrupted); grade.json `contaminated` non-null → contaminated;
    19	#                   --status overrides (transport_error is the batch runner's call)
    20	#   effort_effective per phase: the distinct MODELINV `payload.effort_effective` values of
    21	#                   the rows the phase wrote (its `modelinv_lines` range), comma-joined;
    22	#                   null when no cheval hop ran (DEC-0419)
    23	#   degraded        true when, for any executed phase, (1) a models_used key differs from
    24	#                   model_requested (ids compared without the Bedrock region prefix),
    25	#                   (2) refusal_fallbacks is non-empty, (3) a MODELINV row's
    26	#                   effort_effective differs from the effort it requested (`payload.effort`,
    27	#                   else the phase's effort_requested), or (4) a dissent envelope's
    28	#                   verdict_quality.status is DEGRADED or its completed voices are fewer
    29	#                   than planned; degraded_reason lists every cause ("; "-joined)
    30	#   voices_run      {review, audit} from the envelopes ({planned, completed, quality});
    31	#                   null when neither envelope exists (A0, A4)
    32	#   zone_violations {dot_claude_writes: [{phase, tool, path}]} from Write/Edit/MultiEdit/
    33	#                   NotebookEdit tool inputs under .claude/ in transcripts/events-*.jsonl
    34	#   cost_usd        Σ phase cost_usd (result.total_cost_usd) + Σ phase ledger_cost_usd
    35	#   stalls          number of phases that timed out
    36	#
    37	# Usage:
    38	#   ablation-row.sh --run-dir D --task-yaml F [--grade grade.json] [--manifest MANIFEST.json]
    39	#                   [--status S] [--attempts N] [--retry-reason R] [--out runs.jsonl]
    40	#   ablation-row.sh --validate runs.jsonl [--allow-ungraded]
    41	#
    42	# Options:
    43	#   --run-dir D        the run directory (meta/, sandbox/, transcripts/, eval/)
    44	#   --task-yaml F      the task's task.yaml (id, type)
    45	#   --grade F          grade.json (default <run-dir>/grade.json when present; absent →
    46	#                      every grade field null, a smoke row)
    47	#   --manifest F       batch MANIFEST.json (arm_map, batch, fingerprint, image_digest,
    48	#                      suite_manifest_sha256, suite_version, agy_opt_in)
    49	#   --status S         override the derived status (one of the seven)
    50	#   --attempts N       attempts including transport retries (default 1)
    51	#   --retry-reason R   the retry's reason (default null)
    52	#   --out F            append the row to F (flock when available); default stdout
    53	#   --validate F       check every row's fields, types and enums; exit 1 on the first
    54	#                      bad row naming its line number
    55	#   --allow-ungraded   with --validate: accept rows whose grade fields are all null
    56	#
    57	# Exit codes:
    58	#   0  row written / file valid
    59	#   1  --validate found a bad row
    60	#   2  usage error, unreadable input, arm mismatch
    61	#
    62	# Tested by evals/tests/ablation-row.bats (fixture runs under
    63	# evals/tests/fixtures/ablation-runs/).
    64	# =============================================================================
    65	set -euo pipefail
    66	export LC_ALL=C
    67	
    68	RUN_DIR="" TASK_YAML="" GRADE="" MANIFEST="" STATUS_OVERRIDE="" ATTEMPTS=1 RETRY_REASON="" OUT=""
    69	VALIDATE="" ALLOW_UNGRADED=false
    70	usage() { echo "ablation-row.sh: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
    71	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    72	  case "$1" in
    73	    --run-dir)        RUN_DIR="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    74	    --task-yaml)      TASK_YAML="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    75	    --grade)          GRADE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    76	    --manifest)       MANIFEST="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    77	    --status)         STATUS_OVERRIDE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    78	    --attempts)       ATTEMPTS="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    79	    --retry-reason)   RETRY_REASON="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    80	    --out)            OUT="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    81	    --validate)       VALIDATE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    82	    --allow-ungraded) ALLOW_UNGRADED=true; shift ;;
    83	    -h|--help)        sed -n '2,62p' "$0"; exit 0 ;;
    84	    *) usage "unknown argument: $1" ;;
    85	  esac
    86	done
    87	
    88	STATUSES='["completed","cap_failure","agent_error","transport_error","infrastructure_error","interrupted","contaminated"]'
    89	
    90	# --- validate ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    91	if [[ -n "$VALIDATE" ]]; then
    92	  [[ -f "$VALIDATE" && -r "$VALIDATE" ]] || usage "cannot read $VALIDATE"
    93	  n=0 bad=0
    94	  while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
    95	    n=$((n + 1))
    96	    [[ -n "${line//[[:space:]]/}" ]] || continue

    98	      def t(v; ts): (v | type) as $ty | (ts | index($ty)) != null;
    99	      def need(k; ts): if has(k) | not then "missing field \(k)"
   100	                       elif t(.[k]; ts) | not then "field \(k) has type \(.[k] | type), want \(ts | join("|"))"
   101	                       else empty end;
   102	      def num: ["number"]; def numn: ["number","null"]; def str: ["string"]; def strn: ["string","null"];
   103	      def objn: ["object","null"]; def booln: ["boolean","null"];
   104	      if type != "object" then "row is not a JSON object" else (.) as $row |
   105	      [ need("schema_version"; num), need("run_id"; str), need("batch"; str), need("arm"; str),
   106	        need("task_id"; str), need("task_type"; str), need("trial"; num), need("source_commit"; str),
   107	        need("suite_manifest_sha256"; strn), need("suite_version"; ["number","string","null"]),
   108	        need("host_fingerprint"; strn), need("image_digest"; strn), need("agy_opt_in"; ["boolean"]),
   109	        need("started"; str), need("finished"; strn), need("phases"; ["array"]),
   110	        need("voices_run"; objn), need("hidden_tests"; objn), need("hidden_test_pass_rate"; numn),
   111	        need("defects_seeded"; numn), need("defects_caught"; numn), need("defect_catch_rate"; numn),
   112	        need("flags"; numn), need("false_positives"; numn), need("verdict"; strn),
   113	        need("verdict_accuracy"; booln), need("verdict_accuracy_review"; booln), need("verdict_accuracy_audit"; booln),
   114	        need("regressions"; numn), need("diff_lines"; numn), need("files_changed"; numn),
   115	        need("cost_usd"; num), need("wall_clock_ms"; num), need("tokens_in"; num), need("tokens_out"; num),
   116	        need("stalls"; num), need("attempts"; num), need("retry_reason"; strn),
   117	        need("degraded"; ["boolean"]), need("degraded_reason"; strn), need("status"; str),
   118	        need("snapshots"; ["object"]), need("contaminated"; objn), need("zone_violations"; ["object"]) ][0]
   119	      // (if (["feature-build","bug-fix","refactor","review-catch"] | index($row.task_type)) == null
   120	           then "task_type \(.task_type) is not one of feature-build|bug-fix|refactor|review-catch" else empty end)
   121	      // (if ($st | index($row.status)) == null then "status \(.status) is not one of \($st | join("|"))" else empty end)
   122	      // (if (.zone_violations.dot_claude_writes | type) != "array" then "zone_violations.dot_claude_writes is not an array" else empty end)
   123	      // (if (.degraded == true) and (.degraded_reason == null) then "degraded without degraded_reason" else empty end)
   124	      // (if .verdict != null and ((["APPROVED","CHANGES_REQUIRED"] | index($row.verdict)) == null)
   125	           then "verdict \(.verdict) is not APPROVED|CHANGES_REQUIRED" else empty end)
   126	      // ([.snapshots | to_entries[] | select((.value | type) != "string" and (.value | type) != "null")
   127	           | "snapshots.\(.key) is not a string"][0])
   128	      // ([.phases | to_entries[] | .key as $i | .value as $p
   129	           | ( if ($p | type) != "object" then "phases[\($i)] is not an object" else
   130	               ([ ($p | need("name"; str)), ($p | need("session_id"; strn)), ($p | need("model_requested"; str)),
   131	                  ($p | need("models_used"; ["object"])), ($p | need("effort_requested"; strn)),
   132	                  ($p | need("effort_effective"; strn)), ($p | need("tokens_in"; num)), ($p | need("tokens_out"; num)),
   133	                  ($p | need("cache_read_tokens"; num)), ($p | need("cache_creation_tokens"; num)),
   134	                  ($p | need("cost_usd"; num)), ($p | need("duration_ms"; num)), ($p | need("num_turns"; num)),
   135	                  ($p | need("exit"; num)), ($p | need("refusal_fallbacks"; ["array"])) ][0]
   136	                | if . then "phases[\($i)]: \(.)" else empty end) end )][0])
   137	      // (if $ungraded then empty
   138	          elif (["completed","cap_failure","agent_error","contaminated"] | index($row.status)) == null then empty
   139	          elif .task_type == "review-catch" then
   140	            (if (.defect_catch_rate | type) != "number" then "graded review-catch row has no defect_catch_rate (use --allow-ungraded for smoke rows)" else empty end)
   141	          else
   142	            (if (.hidden_tests | type) != "object" or (.hidden_test_pass_rate | type) != "number"
   143	               then "graded build row has no hidden_tests (use --allow-ungraded for smoke rows)" else empty end)
   144	          end)
   145	      // empty
   146	      end' 2>/dev/null <<<"$line")" || err="line is not valid JSON"
   147	    if [[ -n "$err" ]]; then
   148	      echo "ablation-row.sh: $VALIDATE:$n: $err" >&2

   150	    fi

   155	
   156	# --- build a row -------------------------------------------------------------------------
   157	[[ -n "$RUN_DIR" ]] || usage "missing --run-dir (or --validate)"

   376	regen_sandbox_manifest() {
   377	  local ws="$1"
   378	  [[ -d "$ws" ]] || { _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: workspace not found: $ws"; return 2; }
   379	  if [[ ! -d "$ws/.claude" ]]; then
   380	    _sm_evidence manifest_sha256 "none"

   382	  fi
   383	  local out="$ws/.claude/checksums.json" tool="${EVAL_PROMPT_TREE:-$_SM_REPO_ROOT}/tools/gen-checksums.sh" how="inline"
   384	  if [[ -x "$tool" ]] && git -C "$ws" rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1 \
   385	     && [[ -n "$(git -C "$ws" ls-files .claude 2>/dev/null | head -1)" ]]; then
   386	    "$tool" --root "$ws" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: $tool --root $ws failed"; return 2; }
   387	    how="gen-checksums.sh"
   388	  else
   389	    local list="$ws/.eval/.manifest-files" sums="$ws/.eval/.manifest-sums"
   390	    mkdir -p "$ws/.eval"
   391	    ( cd "$ws" && find .claude -type f ! -path '.claude/overrides/*' ! -path '.claude/checksums.json' -print ) \
   392	      | LC_ALL=C sort > "$list"
   393	    if grep -q '\\' "$list"; then _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: a path under .claude/ holds a backslash"; rm -f "$list"; return 2; fi
   394	    : > "$sums"
   395	    local -a batch=()
   396	    local f
   397	    while IFS= read -r f; do
   398	      batch+=("$f")
   399	      if [[ ${#batch[@]} -ge 200 ]]; then
   400	        ( cd "$ws" && _sm_sha256 "${batch[@]}" ) >> "$sums" || { _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: hashing failed"; return 2; }
   401	        batch=()
   402	      fi
   403	    done < "$list"
   404	    if [[ ${#batch[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
   405	      ( cd "$ws" && _sm_sha256 "${batch[@]}" ) >> "$sums" || { _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: hashing failed"; return 2; }
   406	    fi
   407	    jq -Rn --arg generated "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" '
   408	      {generated: $generated, algorithm: "sha256",
   409	       files: ([inputs | select(length > 0) | capture("^(?<h>[0-9a-f]{64})  (?<p>.+)$") | {key: .p, value: .h}] | from_entries)}' \
   410	      < "$sums" > "$out.tmp" || { rm -f "$out.tmp" "$list" "$sums"; _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: could not write the manifest"; return 2; }
   411	    mv "$out.tmp" "$out"
   412	    rm -f "$list" "$sums"
   413	  fi
   414	  jq -e '.files | type == "object"' "$out" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: $out is not a manifest"; return 2; }
   415	  local digest
   416	  digest="$(_sm_sha256 "$out" | awk '{print $1}')"
   417	  _sm_evidence manifest_files "$(jq '.files | length' "$out") ($how)"
   418	  _sm_evidence manifest_sha256 "$digest"
   419	  return 0
   420	}

content.content:
#       when one cannot take effect or is unknown. Toggles and values:
#         companion_voice: false  flatline_protocol.{code_review,security_audit}.companion_voice=false
#         karpathy_block: false   '## Karpathy Principles' out of CLAUDE.loa.md (+ constraints.json rows)
#         rule_files: false       stash-safety.md, skill-invariants.md out of .claude/rules/
#         audit_delta_instruction: false  the delta paragraph out of auditing-security/SKILL.md
#         loa_mount: false        verifies no .claude/, CLAUDE.md, .loa.config.yaml in <ws>
#                                 (the caller skips mount_prompt_surface); evidence loa_mount=none
#         effort: low|medium|high|xhigh|max
#                                 every `effort:` line out of the frontmatter of every
#                                 <ws>/.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md; every `default_effort` key in
#                                 <ws>/.claude/defaults/model-config.yaml set to the value and its
#                                 .checksum (bare sha256 hex) refreshed when present.
#                                 The caller passes `--effort <v>` on argv.
#         gates: false            flatline_protocol.{code_review,security_audit}.enabled=false;
#                                 LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false exported in the CALLING shell
#                                 and written to $ARM_ENV_FILE (KEY=VALUE lines) when that is set
#         flatline: false         flatline_protocol.enabled=false
#         sprint_plan: false, context_resets: false
#                                 phase-set edits owned by the pipeline executor; recorded as
#                                 evidence here (the single-skill executor refuses them itself)
#   regen_sandbox_manifest <ws>
#       writes <ws>/.claude/checksums.json {generated, algorithm: sha256, files} over
#       every regular file under <ws>/.claude except overrides/ and the manifest
#       itself (LC_ALL=C order, sha256). tools/gen-checksums.sh (in the
#       prompt tree, $EVAL_PROMPT_TREE) is used instead when it exists AND <ws> is a
#       git repository tracking .claude files (it lists `git ls-files`). No .claude/
#       (loa_mount: false) → manifest_sha256=none, exit 0. Prints manifest_sha256=<hex>.
#   check_fixture_path_rule <fixture_dir>
#       exit 2 (offending paths on stderr) when the fixture's top level holds
#       .claude, CLAUDE.md, .loa.config.yaml, grimoires or .run — the mount owns
#       those paths (DEC-0396); exit 0 otherwise.
#   write_sandbox_grimoire <ws> <task_yaml> <arm> <sprint_label>
#       grimoires/loa/ledger.json (one active cycle, <sprint_label> planned, global 1;
#       the ledger-lib.sh schema), NOTES.md (header only), context/task-brief.md (the
#       task's agent-facing `criterion` + the TASK.md next to task.yaml),
#       a2a/<sprint_label>/ (empty); review-catch tasks also get a one-sprint
#       grimoires/loa/sprint.md naming pr/head.diff and a2a/<sprint_label>/reviewer.md
#       carrying pr/PR.md (sandbox copy, else the corpus fixture's). An arm whose
#       toggles carry sprint_plan: false (resolved from $LOA_EVAL_SUITE_FILE, default
#       evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml) gets NO sprint.md. Build tasks leave sprint.md
#       to the PLAN phase. Nothing written names the arm.
#   init_sandbox_beads <ws> <task_title>
#       `br init --prefix bd --no-daemon` in <ws> plus one task bead with the title
#       when br ($LOA_EVAL_BR_BIN, default br) is on PATH → beads=br; else the opt-out
#       marker through <ws>/.claude/scripts/beads/update-beads-state.sh --opt-out →
#       beads=opt-out; neither → beads=none (exit 0).
#
# Hashing is Python hashlib (_sm_sha256), never .claude/ code: see _sm_sha256.
# Callers source this file by a literal relative path (no variable expansion
# on the source line), as eval.yml's trust-boundary scan requires.
#
# Evidence: every function reports `key=value` lines (one line, no newline in
# the value). When ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE is set they are appended to that file;
# else they go to the descriptor in SANDBOX_MOUNT_EVIDENCE_FD (default 1).
# resolve_arm_toggles prints JSON on stdout and no evidence.
#
# Tested by evals/tests/arm-toggles.bats (directly and through execute-agent.sh)
# and evals/tests/execute-agent.bats.
# =============================================================================

[[ "${_SANDBOX_MOUNT_LOADED:-}" == "true" ]] && return 0
_SANDBOX_MOUNT_LOADED=true

_SM_LIB_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
_SM_REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$_SM_LIB_DIR/../../.." && pwd)"

_sm_err() { echo "ERROR: $*" >&2; }

# _sm_sha256 <file>... prints "<hex>  <file>" lines, the sha256sum output shape.
# Python hashlib, not compat-lib's sha256_portable: the eval workflow runs the
# harness as the trusted copy against a PR's .claude/, so no harness script
# sources .claude/ code (eval.yml "Validate grader trust boundary"); run-arms.sh
# hashes the corpus the same way.
_sm_sha256() {
  python3 -I -c '
import hashlib, sys
for p in sys.argv[1:]:
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with open(p, "rb") as f:
        for b in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b""):
            h.update(b)
    print(h.hexdigest() + "  " + p)' "$@"
}

# _sm_evidence <key> <value> — one key=value line to the evidence sink.
_sm_evidence() {
  local line="$1=${2//$'\n'/ }"
  if [[ -n "${ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE:-}" ]]; then
    printf '%s\n' "$line" >> "$ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE"
  else
    local fd="${SANDBOX_MOUNT_EVIDENCE_FD:-1}"
    [[ "$fd" =~ ^[0-9]$ ]] || fd=1
    printf '%s\n' "$line" >&"$fd"
  fi
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
mount_prompt_surface() {
  local ws="$1" tree="$2" skill="${3:-}"
  [[ -d "$ws" ]] || { _sm_err "mount_prompt_surface: workspace not found: $ws"; return 2; }
  [[ -d "$tree/.claude" ]] || { _sm_err "mount_prompt_surface: prompt tree has no .claude/: $tree"; return 2; }
  if [[ "$skill" == "-" ]]; then
    mkdir -p "$ws/.claude"
    cp -a "$tree/.claude/." "$ws/.claude/" || { _sm_err "mount_prompt_surface: copying .claude/ failed"; return 2; }
    printf '@.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md\n' > "$ws/CLAUDE.md"
    if [[ -f "$tree/.loa.config.yaml" ]]; then cp "$tree/.loa.config.yaml" "$ws/.loa.config.yaml"; fi
    _sm_evidence mount "tree"
    return 0
  fi
  case "$skill" in */*|.*|'') _sm_err "invalid skill name '$skill'"; return 2 ;; esac
  local skill_src="$tree/.claude/skills/$skill"
  [[ -f "$skill_src/SKILL.md" ]] || { _sm_err "prompt tree $tree has no .claude/skills/$skill/SKILL.md"; return 2; }
  mkdir -p "$ws/.claude/skills" "$ws/.claude/loa"
  # Whole skill dir (resources included) so guarded reads inside the skill resolve.
  local skill_dst="$ws/.claude/skills/$skill"
  mkdir -p "$skill_dst"
  cp -a "$skill_src/." "$skill_dst/"
  if [[ -f "$tree/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md" ]]; then
    cp "$tree/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md" "$ws/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md"
  fi
  if [[ -d "$tree/.claude/rules" ]]; then
    mkdir -p "$ws/.claude/rules"
    cp -a "$tree/.claude/rules/." "$ws/.claude/rules/"
  fi
  printf '@.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md\n' > "$ws/CLAUDE.md"
  if [[ -n "${LOA_EVAL_ARM+x}" && -f "$tree/.loa.config.yaml" ]]; then
    cp "$tree/.loa.config.yaml" "$ws/.loa.config.yaml"
  fi
  _sm_evidence mount "skill:$skill"
  return 0
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
resolve_arm_toggles() {
  local arm="$1" suite_file="${2:-}"
  [[ "$arm" =~ ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$ ]] || { _sm_err "invalid arm id '$arm'"; return 2; }
  local found=0 entry=""
  if [[ -n "$suite_file" && -f "$suite_file" ]]; then
    # an unreadable suite file reads as "not declared" (cycle-129 behaviour: baseline still resolves to {})
    entry="$(ARM="$arm" yq -o=json -I=0 '[((.arms // [])[]), ((.ab.arms // [])[])] | map(select(.id == strenv(ARM))) | .[0] // null' "$suite_file" 2>/dev/null)" \
      || entry=""
    [[ -n "$entry" && "$entry" != "null" ]] && found=1
  fi
  if [[ "$found" -eq 0 ]]; then
    [[ "$arm" == "baseline" ]] && { printf '{}'; return 0; }
    _sm_err "arm '$arm' is not declared in ${suite_file:-any suite} (arms[] / ab.arms[])"
    return 2
  fi
  if [[ "$(jq -r '.absent // false' <<<"$entry")" == "true" ]]; then
    _sm_err "arm '$arm' is declared absent in $suite_file (never run): $(jq -r '.evidence // "no evidence"' <<<"$entry")"
    return 2
  fi
  local t
  t="$(jq -c '.toggles // {}' <<<"$entry")"
  jq -e 'type == "object"' >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$t" || { _sm_err "arm '$arm' toggles are not an object in $suite_file"; return 2; }
  printf '%s' "$t"
}

# Remove the markdown section that starts at the exact heading line $2 (up to
# the next level-2 heading) from file $1. Prints the number of lines removed.
_sm_drop_md_section() {
  local f="$1" heading="$2" tmpdir="$3" tmp
  tmp="$(mktemp "$tmpdir/.arm.XXXXXX")"
  awk -v h="$heading" '
    $0 == h { skip = 1; n++; next }
    skip && /^## / { skip = 0 }

# _sm_sha256 <file>... prints "<hex>  <file>" lines, the sha256sum output shape.
# Python hashlib, not compat-lib's sha256_portable: the eval workflow runs the
# harness as the trusted copy against a PR's .claude/, so no harness script
# sources .claude/ code (eval.yml "Validate grader trust boundary"); run-arms.sh
# hashes the corpus the same way.
_sm_sha256() {
  python3 -I -c '
import hashlib, sys
for p in sys.argv[1:]:
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with open(p, "rb") as f:
        for b in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b""):
            h.update(b)
    print(h.hexdigest() + "  " + p)' "$@"
}

# _sm_evidence <key> <value> — one key=value line to the evidence sink.
_sm_evidence() {
  local line="$1=${2//$'\n'/ }"
  if [[ -n "${ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE:-}" ]]; then
    printf '%s\n' "$line" >> "$ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE"
  else
    local fd="${SANDBOX_MOUNT_EVIDENCE_FD:-1}"
    [[ "$fd" =~ ^[0-9]$ ]] || fd=1
    printf '%s\n' "$line" >&"$fd"
  fi
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
mount_prompt_surface() {
  local ws="$1" tree="$2" skill="${3:-}"
  [[ -d "$ws" ]] || { _sm_err "mount_prompt_surface: workspace not found: $ws"; return 2; }
  [[ -d "$tree/.claude" ]] || { _sm_err "mount_prompt_surface: prompt tree has no .claude/: $tree"; return 2; }
  if [[ "$skill" == "-" ]]; then
    mkdir -p "$ws/.claude"
    cp -a "$tree/.claude/." "$ws/.claude/" || { _sm_err "mount_prompt_surface: copying .claude/ failed"; return 2; }
    printf '@.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md\n' > "$ws/CLAUDE.md"
    if [[ -f "$tree/.loa.config.yaml" ]]; then cp "$tree/.loa.config.yaml" "$ws/.loa.config.yaml"; fi
    _sm_evidence mount "tree"
    return 0
  fi
  case "$skill" in */*|.*|'') _sm_err "invalid skill name '$skill'"; return 2 ;; esac
  local skill_src="$tree/.claude/skills/$skill"
  [[ -f "$skill_src/SKILL.md" ]] || { _sm_err "prompt tree $tree has no .claude/skills/$skill/SKILL.md"; return 2; }
  mkdir -p "$ws/.claude/skills" "$ws/.claude/loa"
  # Whole skill dir (resources included) so guarded reads inside the skill resolve.
  local skill_dst="$ws/.claude/skills/$skill"
  mkdir -p "$skill_dst"
  cp -a "$skill_src/." "$skill_dst/"
  if [[ -f "$tree/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md" ]]; then
    cp "$tree/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md" "$ws/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md"
  fi
  if [[ -d "$tree/.claude/rules" ]]; then
    mkdir -p "$ws/.claude/rules"
    cp -a "$tree/.claude/rules/." "$ws/.claude/rules/"
  fi
  printf '@.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md\n' > "$ws/CLAUDE.md"
  if [[ -n "${LOA_EVAL_ARM+x}" && -f "$tree/.loa.config.yaml" ]]; then
    cp "$tree/.loa.config.yaml" "$ws/.loa.config.yaml"
  fi
  _sm_evidence mount "skill:$skill"
  return 0
}

resolve_arm_toggles() {
  local arm="$1" suite_file="${2:-}"
  [[ "$arm" =~ ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$ ]] || { _sm_err "invalid arm id '$arm'"; return 2; }
  local found=0 entry=""
  if [[ -n "$suite_file" && -f "$suite_file" ]]; then
    # an unreadable suite file reads as "not declared" (cycle-129 behaviour: baseline still resolves to {})
    entry="$(ARM="$arm" yq -o=json -I=0 '[((.arms // [])[]), ((.ab.arms // [])[])] | map(select(.id == strenv(ARM))) | .[0] // null' "$suite_file" 2>/dev/null)" \
      || entry=""
    [[ -n "$entry" && "$entry" != "null" ]] && found=1
  fi
  if [[ "$found" -eq 0 ]]; then
    [[ "$arm" == "baseline" ]] && { printf '{}'; return 0; }
    _sm_err "arm '$arm' is not declared in ${suite_file:-any suite} (arms[] / ab.arms[])"
    return 2
  fi
  if [[ "$(jq -r '.absent // false' <<<"$entry")" == "true" ]]; then
    _sm_err "arm '$arm' is declared absent in $suite_file (never run): $(jq -r '.evidence // "no evidence"' <<<"$entry")"
    return 2
  fi
  local t
  t="$(jq -c '.toggles // {}' <<<"$entry")"
  jq -e 'type == "object"' >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$t" || { _sm_err "arm '$arm' toggles are not an object in $suite_file"; return 2; }
  printf '%s' "$t"
}

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# fingerprint.sh — toolchain fingerprint for ablation runs (cycle-130 FR-4, SDD A11 / DEC-0389)
     4	#
     5	# Prints `fp:<sha256>` over the LC_ALL=C-sorted `tool=version` lines of the
     6	# toolchain an ablation run depends on (claude, codex, python3, node, yq, jq,
     7	# bats, git, docker) plus `source_tree=<HEAD of --source-tree>`. A tool that is
     8	# not installed reads `tool=absent`, so a missing tool changes the fingerprint
     9	# instead of failing the run. The value fills `image_digest` in host mode and
    10	# `fingerprint` in every mode (MANIFEST.json, pipeline.json, runs.jsonl). It reads the
    11	# HOST toolchain: in container mode the phases run on the image's toolchain, and the
    12	# image digest (not this value) identifies the batch's versions (on 2026-10-15 the host
    13	# CLI was 2.1.300 while Dockerfile.ablation pins 2.1.299).
    14	#
    15	# Usage:
    16	#   fingerprint.sh [--source-tree DIR] [--claude-bin B] [--bats-bin B] [--json]
    17	#
    18	# Options:
    19	#   --source-tree DIR  the pinned Loa tree; its `git rev-parse HEAD` is folded in
    20	#                      (`none` when absent or not a git tree)
    21	#   --claude-bin B     the CLI executable (default: $EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN, else claude)
    22	#   --bats-bin B       bats executable (default: bats on PATH, else the operator's
    23	#                      ~/.local/dotfiles/tools/diff-so-fancy/test/bats/bin/bats)
    24	#   --json             print {fingerprint, tools{}, source_tree, lines[]} instead
    25	#
    26	# Exit codes:
    27	#   0  printed
    28	#   2  usage error
    29	#
    30	# Tested by evals/tests/pipeline-run.bats (fingerprint cases).
    31	# =============================================================================
    32	set -euo pipefail
    33	export LC_ALL=C
    34	
    35	# Hashing is Python hashlib: no harness script sources .claude/ code (eval.yml
    36	# "Validate grader trust boundary").
    37	
    38	SOURCE_TREE=""
    39	CLAUDE_BIN="${EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN:-claude}"
    40	BATS_BIN="${LOA_EVAL_BATS_BIN:-}"
    41	JSON=false
    42	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    43	  case "$1" in
    44	    --source-tree) SOURCE_TREE="${2:?--source-tree needs a value}"; shift 2 ;;
    45	    --claude-bin)  CLAUDE_BIN="${2:?--claude-bin needs a value}"; shift 2 ;;
    46	    --bats-bin)    BATS_BIN="${2:?--bats-bin needs a value}"; shift 2 ;;
    47	    --json)        JSON=true; shift ;;
    48	    -h|--help)     sed -n '2,28p' "$0"; exit 0 ;;
    49	    *) echo "fingerprint.sh: unknown argument: $1" >&2; exit 2 ;;
    50	  esac
    51	done
    52	if [[ -z "$BATS_BIN" ]]; then
    53	  if command -v bats >/dev/null 2>&1; then BATS_BIN=bats
    54	  else BATS_BIN="$HOME/.local/dotfiles/tools/diff-so-fancy/test/bats/bin/bats"; fi
    55	fi
    56	
    57	# first line of `<bin> <args>`, whitespace collapsed; `absent` when not runnable
    58	tool_version() {  # tool_version <bin> <args...>
    59	  local bin="$1"; shift
    60	  if ! command -v "$bin" >/dev/null 2>&1 && [[ ! -x "$bin" ]]; then printf 'absent'; return 0; fi
    61	  local out
    62	  out="$("$bin" "$@" 2>&1 < /dev/null || true)"
    63	  out="$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | sed -n '1p' | tr -s ' \t' ' ' | sed 's/^ //; s/ $//')"
    64	  [[ -n "$out" ]] || out="unknown"
    65	  printf '%s' "$out"
    66	}
    67	
    68	lines="$(
    69	  {
    70	    printf 'claude=%s\n'  "$(tool_version "$CLAUDE_BIN" --version)"
    71	    printf 'codex=%s\n'   "$(tool_version codex --version)"
    72	    printf 'python3=%s\n' "$(tool_version python3 --version)"
    73	    printf 'node=%s\n'    "$(tool_version node --version)"
    74	    printf 'yq=%s\n'      "$(tool_version yq --version)"
    75	    printf 'jq=%s\n'      "$(tool_version jq --version)"
    76	    printf 'bats=%s\n'    "$(tool_version "$BATS_BIN" --version)"

     6	# "<sha256>  <relpath>" line per file under <root>/tasks/ (and <root>/smoke/
     7	# with --smoke), relpath relative to the root, LC_ALL=C sorted, sha256 (Python
     8	# hashlib: no harness script sources .claude/ code, eval.yml trust boundary).

    18	#   --suite-file F    passed to validate-suite.sh

    21	# or `freeze: OK — N files match MANIFEST.sha256 (sha256 …)`; on drift every
    22	# changed / added / removed path on its own line.

    29	export LC_ALL=C

    31	SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
    32	REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
    33	
    34	ROOT="$REPO_ROOT/grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0"

    36	VARGS=()

    84	  rm -f "$list"
    85	}

    91	n="$(grep -c . "$TMP" || true)"

    93	if [[ "$CHECK" == "true" ]]; then
    94	  [[ -f "$MANIFEST" ]] || { echo "freeze: no MANIFEST.sha256 in $ROOT (run freeze.sh first)" >&2; exit 1; }
    95	  if cmp -s "$TMP" "$MANIFEST"; then
    96	    echo "freeze: OK — $n files match MANIFEST.sha256 (sha256 $(digest_of "$MANIFEST"))"

    98	  fi
    99	  echo "freeze: DRIFT against $MANIFEST:"

   101	import sys
   102	def load(p):
   103	    m = {}
   104	    for line in open(p, encoding="utf-8"):
   105	        line = line.rstrip("\n")
   106	        if line:
   107	            h, _, rel = line.partition("  ")
   108	            m[rel] = h
   109	    return m
   110	old, new = load(sys.argv[1]), load(sys.argv[2])
   111	for rel in sorted(set(old) | set(new)):
   112	    if rel not in new:
   113	        print(f"  removed  {rel}")
   114	    elif rel not in old:
   115	        print(f"  added    {rel}")
   116	    elif old[rel] != new[rel]:
   117	        print(f"  changed  {rel}")
   118	PY
   119	  exit 1
   120	fi
   121	
   122	cp "$TMP" "$MANIFEST.tmp" && mv "$MANIFEST.tmp" "$MANIFEST"
   123	echo "freeze: wrote MANIFEST.sha256 ($n files, sha256 $(digest_of "$MANIFEST"))"
   124	exit 0

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# pipeline-run.sh — the cycle-130 ablation pipeline executor (SDD §1.4 D-4.1 … D-4.10, §5.6)
     4	#
     5	# Runs ONE task under ONE arm: materialises a sandbox repository (the task's
     6	# fixture tree, or the review-catch PR under pr/, plus the Loa mount from the
     7	# pinned --source-tree), then drives Loa's phases as separate `claude -p`
     8	# sessions inside it, records every phase, enforces the per-run cap and writes
     9	# meta/pipeline.json. One executor serves every task type (D-4.1):
    10	#   review-catch                      REVIEW → AUDIT
    11	#   bug-fix | refactor | feature-build PLAN → IMPLEMENT → REVIEW → FIX? → AUDIT → FIX?
    12	# A FIX runs only when the gate before it wrote a CHANGES_REQUIRED LOA-VERDICT
    13	# trailer (the last `<!-- LOA-VERDICT {…} -->` line of
    14	# grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/engineer-feedback.md resp. auditor-sprint-feedback.md);
    15	# a FIX that does not run is recorded `skipped: true`.
    16	# Arms edit the phase set (D-4.2): `sprint_plan: false` drops PLAN; `gates: false`
    17	# ends after IMPLEMENT; `loa_mount: false` runs one BARE session (no mount);
    18	# `flatline: false` keeps PLAN with the Flatline step off; `context_resets: false`
    19	# runs PLAN, IMPLEMENT and FIX as ONE implementer session (`--resume <session_id>`
    20	# from the first session's system/init event) while REVIEW and AUDIT stay separate.
    21	# The suite's `phase_sets[<review-catch|build>]` and an arm's `phases` override the
    22	# default phase list; the toggle edits above apply on top.
    23	#
    24	# Usage:
    25	#   pipeline-run.sh --task-yaml F --arm ID --run-dir D --run-id R --trial N \
    26	#                   --source-tree DIR --suite-file F [--max-run-usd 12] \
    27	#                   [--executor container|host] [--image IMG] [--claude-bin B] \
    28	#                   [--docker-bin D] [--phase-models JSON] [--phase-timeouts JSON] [--dry-run]
    29	#
    30	# Options:
    31	#   --task-yaml F       task.yaml (SDD §3.2); its directory holds TASK.md
    32	#   --arm ID            arm id declared in the suite file (`arms[].id`)
    33	#   --run-dir D         run directory to create (must not exist or be empty);
    34	#                       alias --workspace
    35	#   --run-id R          run id recorded in pipeline.json
    36	#   --trial N           trial number
    37	#   --source-tree DIR   the pinned Loa tree the mount is copied from
    38	#   --suite-file F      evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml (read with yq -o=json)
    39	#   --max-run-usd USD   per-run cap (default 12; config evals.ablation.run_cap_usd)
    40	#   --executor MODE     container (default; DEC-0411) or host
    41	#   --image IMG         container image (default loa-ablation:258)
    42	#   --claude-bin B      host-mode CLI (default $EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN, else claude)
    43	#   --docker-bin D      docker CLI (default $EVAL_DOCKER_BIN, else docker)
    44	#   --phase-models JSON {"PLAN": "<model id>", …} override ($LOA_EVAL_PHASE_MODELS)
    45	#   --phase-timeouts JSON {"IMPLEMENT": <seconds>, …} override
    46	#   --dry-run           print the phase plan and exit 0; nothing is created
    47	#
    48	# Run directory layout (DEC-0413 — the grader never reads meta/):
    49	#   sandbox/     the agent's tree (its own .git initialised at `base`)
    50	#   snapshots/   <label>.bundle + index.json ({IMPLEMENT|FIX1|FIX2: commit}) after
    51	#                IMPLEMENT and each FIX
    52	#   transcripts/ events-<label>.jsonl (stream-json), stderr-<label>.log
    53	#   eval/        model-invoke.jsonl, cost-ledger.jsonl (copied out of
    54	#                sandbox/.eval/ after every phase), adversarial-*.json
    55	#   meta/        pipeline.json, phase-<label>.argv.json (argv + captured env),
    56	#                prompt-<label>.md, arm, arm-evidence.txt, arm-env, refused.json,
    57	#                home/ (container mode: the per-run HOME; deleted at exit)
    58	#
    59	# Session (D-4.3, DEC-0394 as amended, DEC-0412): `claude -p <prompt> --output-format
    60	# stream-json --verbose --model <id> --permission-mode bypassPermissions
    61	# --dangerously-skip-permissions --setting-sources project --tools <list>
    62	# --max-turns <cap> [--effort <v>] [--resume <id>]`, cwd sandbox/, with exactly this
    63	# environment: PATH HOME LANG LC_ALL TERM TMPDIR CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK
    64	# CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL LOA_MODELINV_LOG_PATH LOA_COST_LEDGER_PATH
    65	# GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GH_CONFIG_DIR=<sandbox/.eval/gh-empty>,
    66	# the Bedrock route's pass-through keys when set in the driver's environment
    67	# (AWS_REGION AWS_DEFAULT_REGION AWS_PROFILE AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK
    68	# ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_REGION_PREFIX ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_{OPUS,SONNET,HAIKU}_MODEL), and the
    69	# arm's LOA_* variables (LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false for gates: false).
    70	# A python3 -I exec shim closes every descriptor above 2 and keeps exactly those keys;
    71	# values reach it through the environment, never argv, so AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK
    72	# appears in no argv, capture or log (phase-<label>.argv.json records it as "<set>").
    73	# `timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=15` bounds the CLI.
    74	# Container mode (D-4.9, DEC-0411 as amended) runs the same command inside
    75	#   docker run --rm --name <n> --user <uid>:<gid> --network bridge --read-only
    76	#     --tmpfs /tmp:rw,size=1g --pids-limit 512 --memory 4g --cpus 2
    77	#     -v <run>/sandbox:/workspace:rw -v <run>/meta/home:/home/evaluser:rw
    78	#     -w /workspace -e <KEY=value…> -e AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK <image> python3 -I -c <shim> … claude …
    79	# Exactly two mounts. meta/home/ (mode 0700) holds copies of $HOME/.codex/{auth.json,
    80	# config.toml} when present and empty .claude/ and .aws/; the CLI's session store
    81	# lives there for the whole run, so A6's --resume works across phases. No ~/.claude
    82	# file is ever copied. The directory is deleted at exit and on interrupt.
    83	# image_digest = the image's RepoDigest or id (container), else the fingerprint (host).
    84	# Versions: `fingerprint` is computed from the HOST toolchain; in container mode the
    85	# toolchain that runs the phases is the image's (Claude Code 2.1.299, codex 0.137.0 by
    86	# Dockerfile.ablation), so image_digest identifies the batch's versions. On 2026-10-15
    87	# the host CLI was 2.1.300 while the image pins 2.1.299; every arm runs in the container.
    88	#
    89	# Cap and watchdog (D-4.6, D-4.10): while a phase runs the driver re-prices the
    90	# stream's assistant-turn usage every $LOA_EVAL_WATCHDOG_POLL_S seconds (default 1)
    91	# from per-token prices fetched once per model (pricing.py; $LOA_EVAL_PRICING_JSON
    92	# overrides) and SIGTERMs the phase when spent + estimate ≥ the cap (cap_turn
    93	# recorded). After each phase the result's total_cost_usd (authoritative) plus the
    94	# sandbox cost-ledger rows written during the phase are added; ≥ cap → cap_failure.
    95	#
    96	# Exit codes:
    97	#   0  finished (any verdict)                                   status completed
    98	#   1  agent error: a phase exited non-zero or timed out        status agent_error
    99	#   2  infrastructure: usage, refused arm/type, mount/toggle failure, CLI/docker
   100	#      or image missing, fixture path rule, leak guard          status infrastructure_error
   101	#   3  cap failure (run stopped at the cap)                     status cap_failure
   102	#   4  interrupted (SIGTERM/SIGINT/SIGHUP to the driver, or a phase killed from
   103	#      outside)                                                 status interrupted
   104	# pipeline.json is written for every exit except usage errors and --dry-run; it is
   105	# rewritten with status `running` after each phase so a SIGKILLed driver leaves a
   106	# record (ablation-row.sh reads `running` as interrupted).
   107	#
   108	# Env: EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN, EVAL_DOCKER_BIN, LOA_EVAL_PHASE_MODELS, LOA_EVAL_PRICING_JSON,
   109	# LOA_EVAL_WATCHDOG_POLL_S, LOA_EVAL_CREDS_HOME (where ~/.codex is read; default $HOME),
   110	# LOA_EVAL_CONTAINER_CLAUDE_BIN (default claude), LOA_EVAL_EXECUTOR.
   111	#

   214	# plan_phases <toggles-json> → JSON array of {name,label}
   215	plan_phases() {

   217	    ( if $kind == "review-catch" then ["REVIEW","AUDIT"] else ["PLAN","IMPLEMENT","REVIEW","FIX","AUDIT","FIX"] end ) as $dflt

   235	builtin_model() { case "$1" in REVIEW|AUDIT) echo global.anthropic.claude-fable-5-1 ;; *) echo global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5 ;; esac; }
   236	builtin_turns() { case "$1" in PLAN) echo 30 ;; IMPLEMENT) echo 60 ;; REVIEW|FIX|AUDIT) echo 40 ;; BARE) echo 170 ;; *) echo 40 ;; esac; }
   237	builtin_tmin()  { case "$1" in PLAN) echo 15 ;; IMPLEMENT) echo 25 ;; REVIEW|AUDIT) echo 20 ;; FIX) echo 15 ;; BARE) echo 70 ;; *) echo 20 ;; esac; }

   239	phase_model() {

   243	phase_cap() {  # phase_cap <name> max_turns|timeout_min — task bounds > suite phase_defaults > built-in;
   244	               # BARE without a declaration = PLAN + IMPLEMENT + 2 × FIX
   245	  local n="$1" key="$2" v
   246	  v="$(jq -r --arg n "$n" --arg k "$key" '.bounds[$k][$n] // empty' <<<"$TASK_JSON")"
   247	  [[ -n "$v" ]] || v="$(jq -r --arg n "$n" --arg k "$key" '.phase_defaults[$k][$n] // empty' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"

   249	    v=$(( $(phase_cap PLAN "$key") + $(phase_cap IMPLEMENT "$key") + 2 * $(phase_cap FIX "$key") ))
   250	  fi
   251	  if [[ -z "$v" ]]; then
   252	    if [[ "$key" == max_turns ]]; then v="$(builtin_turns "$n")"; else v="$(builtin_tmin "$n")"; fi
   253	  fi
   254	  printf '%s' "$v"
   255	}

     3	# pipeline-run.sh — the cycle-130 ablation pipeline executor (SDD §1.4 D-4.1 … D-4.10, §5.6)
     4	#
     5	# Runs ONE task under ONE arm: materialises a sandbox repository (the task's
     6	# fixture tree, or the review-catch PR under pr/, plus the Loa mount from the
     7	# pinned --source-tree), then drives Loa's phases as separate `claude -p`
     8	# sessions inside it, records every phase, enforces the per-run cap and writes
     9	# meta/pipeline.json. One executor serves every task type (D-4.1):
    10	#   review-catch                      REVIEW → AUDIT
    11	#   bug-fix | refactor | feature-build PLAN → IMPLEMENT → REVIEW → FIX? → AUDIT → FIX?
    12	# A FIX runs only when the gate before it wrote a CHANGES_REQUIRED LOA-VERDICT
    13	# trailer (the last `<!-- LOA-VERDICT {…} -->` line of
    14	# grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/engineer-feedback.md resp. auditor-sprint-feedback.md);
    15	# a FIX that does not run is recorded `skipped: true`.
    16	# Arms edit the phase set (D-4.2): `sprint_plan: false` drops PLAN; `gates: false`
    17	# ends after IMPLEMENT; `loa_mount: false` runs one BARE session (no mount);
    18	# `flatline: false` keeps PLAN with the Flatline step off; `context_resets: false`
    19	# runs PLAN, IMPLEMENT and FIX as ONE implementer session (`--resume <session_id>`
    20	# from the first session's system/init event) while REVIEW and AUDIT stay separate.
    21	# The suite's `phase_sets[<review-catch|build>]` and an arm's `phases` override the
    22	# default phase list; the toggle edits above apply on top.
    23	#
    24	# Usage:
    25	#   pipeline-run.sh --task-yaml F --arm ID --run-dir D --run-id R --trial N \
    26	#                   --source-tree DIR --suite-file F [--max-run-usd 12] \
    27	#                   [--executor container|host] [--image IMG] [--claude-bin B] \
    28	#                   [--docker-bin D] [--phase-models JSON] [--phase-timeouts JSON] [--dry-run]
    29	#
    30	# Options:
    31	#   --task-yaml F       task.yaml (SDD §3.2); its directory holds TASK.md
    32	#   --arm ID            arm id declared in the suite file (`arms[].id`)
    33	#   --run-dir D         run directory to create (must not exist or be empty);
    34	#                       alias --workspace

    36	#   --trial N           trial number

   576	# --- pricing (one lookup per model; D-4.10) ---------------------------------------------
   577	PRICE_CACHE=""
   578	price_for() {  # price_for <model id> → {"in":…,"out":…,"cr":…,"cc":…} micro-USD per Mtok, or null
   579	  local m="$1" hit alias j
   580	  hit="$(printf '%s\n' "$PRICE_CACHE" | awk -F'\t' -v m="$m" '$1 == m {print $2; exit}')"
   581	  [[ -n "$hit" ]] && { printf '%s' "$hit"; return 0; }
   582	  if [[ -n "${LOA_EVAL_PRICING_JSON:-}" ]]; then
   583	    j="$(jq -c --arg m "$m" '.[$m] // null' <<<"$LOA_EVAL_PRICING_JSON" 2>/dev/null || echo null)"
   584	  else
   585	    alias="$(printf '%s' "$m" | sed -E 's/^([a-z]+\.)?anthropic\.//; s/-v[0-9]+(:[0-9]+)?$//')"
   586	    j="$(cd "$REPO_ROOT/.claude/adapters" && python3 -I "$REPO_ROOT/.claude/adapters/loa_cheval/metering/pricing.py" \
   587	          --alias "$alias" --json 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1p' || true)"
   588	    [[ -n "$j" ]] || j=null
   589	  fi
   590	  j="$(jq -c 'if (type == "object") and (.input_per_mtok != null) and (.output_per_mtok != null)
   591	              then {in: .input_per_mtok, out: .output_per_mtok,
   592	                    cr: (.cache_read_per_mtok // (.input_per_mtok * 0.1)),
   593	                    cc: (.cache_write_per_mtok // .cache_creation_per_mtok // (.input_per_mtok * 1.25))}
   594	              else null end' <<<"$j" 2>/dev/null || echo null)"

   598	# price_events <events> <prices> <budget_micro> → "<turns> <estimate_micro> <crossing_turn|0>"
   599	price_events() {
   600	  jq -R -n -r --argjson p "$2" --argjson budget "$3" '
   601	    def cost(u): ((u.input_tokens // 0) * $p.in + (u.output_tokens // 0) * $p.out
   602	                  + (u.cache_read_input_tokens // 0) * $p.cr + (u.cache_creation_input_tokens // 0) * $p.cc) / 1000000;
   603	    reduce (inputs | fromjson? | select(type == "object" and .type == "assistant"
   604	                                        and ((.message.usage // null) | type) == "object")) as $e
   605	      ({order: [], u: {}, n: 0};
   606	       .n += 1
   607	       | ($e.message.id // ("event-" + (.n | tostring))) as $id
   608	       | (if .u[$id] == null then .order += [$id] else . end)
   609	       | .u[$id] = $e.message.usage)
   610	    | [.order[] as $id | cost(.u[$id])] as $c
   611	    | (reduce range(0; $c | length) as $i ({s: 0, x: 0};
   612	         if .x == 0 then (.s += $c[$i]) | (if .s >= $budget then .x = ($i + 1) else . end) else . end)) as $r
   613	    | "\($c | length) \(($c | add // 0) | round) \($r.x)"' 2>/dev/null < "$1" || echo "0 0 0"
   614	}

   122	rule_no_audit_rows() {

   126	rule_all_phases_present() {

   138	rule_no_plan_phase() {

   156	rule_no_gate_phases() {

   161	rule_enforce_env_false() {

   171	rule_no_flatline_rows() {

   182	rule_implementer_single_session() {
   183	  local ids n sid f bad=""

   204	  [[ "$r" != null && "$a" != null ]] || { EVID="gate session ids review=$r audit=$a"; return 1; }

   220	rule_skill_effort_stripped() {
   221	  local f n=0 hit=0

   224	    n=$((n + 1))

   226	    awk 'NR == 1 && $0 != "---" {exit} NR > 1 && $0 == "---" {exit} NR > 1 && /^effort:/ {hit = 1; exit} END {exit !hit}' "$f" \
   227	      && hit=$((hit + 1))

   229	  [[ $n -gt 0 ]] || { EVID="no sandbox SKILL.md"; return 1; }
   230	  [[ $hit -eq 0 ]] || { EVID="$hit/$n SKILL.md still carry effort:"; return 1; }
   231	  EVID="skill effort lines stripped $n/$n"

   233	rule_integrity_clean() {
   234	  local man="$R/sandbox/.claude/checksums.json" msha out
   235	  if [[ "$(jq -r '.arm_toggles.loa_mount' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")" == false ]]; then
   236	    [[ -e "$R/sandbox/.claude" ]] && { EVID="loa_mount: false but sandbox has .claude/"; return 1; }
   237	    EVID="no mount (loa_mount: false)"; return 0
   238	  fi
   239	  msha="$(jq -r '.arm_evidence.manifest_sha256 // empty' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   240	  [[ -n "$msha" && "$msha" != none ]] || { EVID="no arm_evidence.manifest_sha256"; return 1; }
   241	  [[ -f "$man" ]] && jq -e '.files | type == "object"' "$man" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { EVID="no sandbox .claude/checksums.json files map"; return 1; }
   242	  # one hashlib walk over every manifest entry: "<n> <tampered> <missing> <file-sha> <first problem>"
   243	  out="$(python3 -I -c '
   244	import hashlib, json, os, sys
   245	root, man = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
   246	def sha(p):
   247	    h = hashlib.sha256()
   248	    with open(p, "rb") as f:
   249	        for b in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b""):
   250	            h.update(b)
   251	    return h.hexdigest()
   252	files = json.load(open(man)).get("files") or {}
   253	bad = missing = 0; first = "-"
   254	for rel, want in sorted(files.items()):
   255	    p = os.path.join(root, rel)
   256	    if not os.path.isfile(p):
   257	        missing += 1; first = first if first != "-" else "missing " + rel
   258	    elif sha(p) != want:
   259	        bad += 1; first = first if first != "-" else "tampered " + rel
   260	print(len(files), bad, missing, sha(man), first)' "$R/sandbox" "$man")" || { EVID="hash walk failed"; return 1; }
   261	  local n bad missing filesha first
   262	  read -r n bad missing filesha first <<<"$out"
   263	  [[ "$n" -gt 0 ]] || { EVID="manifest lists no files"; return 1; }
   264	  if [[ "$bad" -gt 0 || "$missing" -gt 0 ]]; then EVID="$bad tampered, $missing missing of $n ($first)"; return 1; fi
   265	  EVID="$n manifest entries verified; manifest_sha256 ${msha:0:12}"
   266	  [[ "$filesha" == "$msha" ]] && EVID="$EVID (matches checksums.json)"
   267	  return 0
   268	}
   269	rule_applicability_refused() {
   270	  local f="$R/meta/refused.json" a t
   271	  if [[ ! -f "$f" ]]; then
   272	    # a run that was not refused: its task type must be one the arm declares
   273	    t="$(jq -r '.task_type // ""' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   274	    local k=build; [[ "$t" == review-catch ]] && k=review-catch
   275	    if jq -e --arg k "$k" --arg t "$t" '(.task_types // ["all"]) as $tt | ($tt | index("all")) or ($tt | index($k)) or ($tt | index($t))' \
   276	         <<<"$ARM_DEF" >/dev/null; then
   277	      EVID="applicable: $t in task_types $(jq -c '.task_types // null' <<<"$ARM_DEF") (no refusal needed)"; return 0
   278	    fi
   279	    EVID="ran on $t outside task_types $(jq -c '.task_types // null' <<<"$ARM_DEF") without a refusal record"; return 1
   280	  fi
   281	  a="$(jq -r '.arm // ""' "$f")"; t="$(jq -r '.type // ""' "$f")"
   282	  [[ "$a" == "$ARM" && -n "$t" ]] || { EVID="refusal record names arm '$a' type '$t'"; return 1; }
   283	  local kind=build; [[ "$t" == review-catch ]] && kind=review-catch
   284	  if jq -e --arg k "$kind" --arg t "$t" '(.task_types // ["all"]) as $tt | ($tt | index("all")) or ($tt | index($k)) or ($tt | index($t))' \
   285	       <<<"$ARM_DEF" >/dev/null; then
   286	    EVID="arm task_types $(jq -c '.task_types' <<<"$ARM_DEF") include $t, yet the run was refused"; return 1
   287	  fi
   288	  EVID="refused $t (task_types $(jq -c '.task_types // null' <<<"$ARM_DEF"))"
   289	}
   290	
   291	# ---- one run ------------------------------------------------------------------------
   292	check_run() {  # check_run <run-dir> → prints lines; returns 0/1; 2 on usage problems
   293	  R="$1"
   294	  local arm rules rule fails=0 total=0 results='[]' ok
   295	  if [[ -n "$ARM_OPT" ]]; then arm="$ARM_OPT"
   296	  elif [[ -f "$R/meta/arm" ]]; then arm="$(sed -n '1p' "$R/meta/arm" | tr -d '[:space:]')"
   297	  elif [[ -f "$R/meta/refused.json" ]]; then arm="$(jq -r '.arm // ""' "$R/meta/refused.json")"
   298	  else arm="$(jq -r '.arm // ""' "$R/meta/pipeline.json" 2>/dev/null || true)"; fi
   299	  [[ -n "$arm" ]] || { echo "took-effect.sh: no arm for $R" >&2; return 2; }
   300	  ARM="$arm"
   301	  ARM_DEF="$(jq -c --arg a "$arm" '[.arms // [] | .[] | select(.id == $a)][0] // empty' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
   302	  [[ -n "$ARM_DEF" ]] || { echo "took-effect.sh: arm $arm is not declared in the suite" >&2; return 2; }
   303	  if [[ "$(jq -r '.absent // false' <<<"$ARM_DEF")" == true ]]; then
   304	    if [[ "$JSON" == true ]]; then jq -nc --arg d "$R" --arg arm "$arm" '{run_dir: $d, arm: $arm, ok: true, absent: true, rules: []}'
   305	    else printf 'arm %s: absent (component-absent; no rules)\n' "$arm"; fi
   306	    return 0
   307	  fi
   308	  if [[ -f "$R/meta/refused.json" ]]; then
   309	    rules="applicability_refused"
   310	  else
   311	    [[ -f "$R/meta/pipeline.json" ]] || { echo "took-effect.sh: no meta/pipeline.json under $R" >&2; return 2; }
   312	    rules="$(jq -r '(.took_effect // []) | .[]' <<<"$ARM_DEF")"
   313	    [[ -n "$rules" ]] || { echo "took-effect.sh: arm $arm lists no took_effect rules" >&2; return 2; }
   314	  fi
   315	  while IFS= read -r rule; do
   316	    [[ -n "$rule" ]] || continue
   317	    total=$((total + 1)); EVID=""
   318	    if declare -F "rule_$rule" >/dev/null; then
   319	      if "rule_$rule"; then ok=true; else ok=false; fi
   320	    else
   321	      ok=false; EVID="unknown rule id"
   322	    fi
   323	    [[ "$ok" == true ]] || fails=$((fails + 1))
   324	    if [[ "$JSON" == true ]]; then
   325	      results="$(jq -c --arg r "$rule" --argjson ok "$ok" --arg e "$EVID" '. + [{rule: $r, ok: $ok, evidence: $e}]' <<<"$results")"
   326	    else
   327	      printf 'arm %s: %s %s %s\n' "$arm" "$rule" "$([[ "$ok" == true ]] && echo OK || echo FAIL)" "$EVID"
   328	    fi
   329	  done <<<"$rules"
   330	  if [[ "$JSON" == true ]]; then
   331	    jq -nc --arg d "$R" --arg arm "$arm" --argjson rules "$results" --argjson ok "$([[ $fails -eq 0 ]] && echo true || echo false)" \
   332	      '{run_dir: $d, arm: $arm, ok: $ok, rules: $rules}'
   333	  elif [[ $fails -eq 0 ]]; then
   334	    printf 'arm %s: OK\n' "$arm"
   335	  else
   336	    printf 'arm %s: FAIL (%d of %d rules)\n' "$arm" "$fails" "$total"
   337	  fi
   338	  [[ $fails -eq 0 ]]
   339	}
   340	
   341	if [[ -n "$RUN_DIR" ]]; then
   342	  [[ -d "$RUN_DIR" ]] || usage "run dir not found: $RUN_DIR"
   343	  rc=0; check_run "$RUN_DIR" || rc=$?
   344	  exit "$rc"
   345	fi
   346	
   347	[[ -d "$BATCH_DIR" ]] || usage "batch dir not found: $BATCH_DIR"
   348	runs=0 failed=0
   349	while IFS= read -r d; do
   350	  runs=$((runs + 1))
   351	  rc=0; check_run "$d" || rc=$?
   352	  [[ $rc -eq 2 ]] && exit 2
   353	  [[ $rc -eq 0 ]] || failed=$((failed + 1))
   354	done < <(find "$BATCH_DIR" -mindepth 2 -maxdepth 4

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# validate-suite.sh — cycle-130 ablation task-suite validator (SDD §3.2, DEC-0424)
     4	#
     5	# Checks every task of the ablation-2.0 suite before it is frozen, run or graded.
     6	#
     7	# Usage:
     8	#   validate-suite.sh [--root DIR] [--smoke] [--allow-partial] [--suite-file F]
     9	#
    10	#   --root DIR        suite root (default grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0); the
    11	#                     tasks are <root>/tasks/<id>/task.yaml
    12	#   --smoke           also validate <root>/smoke/<id>/task.yaml (never counted)
    13	#   --allow-partial   skip the four-by-four type count (Sprint 258 state)
    14	#   --suite-file F    suite yaml (default evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml): arm ids
    15	#                     for the leakage check, arms' task_types, suite_version
    16	#
    17	# Checks (each violation is one stdout line `<task-id>: <reason>`):
    18	#   1. schema: id (= directory name), schema_version 1, type (feature-build |
    19	#      bug-fix | refactor | review-catch), source {kind, date, fix_commit?,
    20	#      base_commit?, bead?, origin?}, post_cutoff (bool), fixture (dir under the
    21	#      root; null only for review-catch), criterion (agent-facing; no path, file
    22	#      name or test name), success_criterion, test_command (array; null only for
    23	#      review-catch), regression_command (array | null), reference_patch (hidden/…
    24	#      | null; required for bug-fix and feature-build), grader_protected (array of
    25	#      relative paths present in the fixture), structural_check (hidden/… | null;
    26	#      required for refactor), bounds {max_turns{}, timeout_min{}} (phase → positive
    27	#      int), review_catch (null, or {fixture, manifest, labels?} for review-catch,
    28	#      both present), suite_version (= the suite file's), TASK.md present
    29	#   2. counts: four tasks of each type under tasks/ (unless --allow-partial)
    30	#   3. allowlist: test_command[0] and regression_command[0] in python3 | pytest |
    31	#      bats | bash | node | npx
    32	#   4. hidden/manifest.json (build types): {"files": [{src, dest}]}; every src
    33	#      exists under hidden/; every dest is relative, inside the tree, no `..`
    34	#   5. fixture path rule (build types): check_fixture_path_rule from
    35	#      lib/sandbox-mount.sh — no .claude/, CLAUDE.md, .loa.config.yaml, grimoires/
    36	#      or .run/ at the fixture's top level; the reference patch touches none either
    37	#   6. leakage: TASK.md and criterion (the task-brief text is built from these)
    38	#      and every phase prompt under evals/harness/lib/phase-prompts/ contain none
    39	#      of: the string `hidden` (any case), a hidden test file's stem, a defect id
    40	#      of the review manifest, a `D[0-9]{2}-` key, an arm id of the suite file
    41	#   7. suite file: every non-absent arm's task_types are known (all | build |
    42	#      review-catch | feature-build | bug-fix | refactor)
    43	#
    44	# Exit: 0 valid; 1 violations (every one listed); 2 usage / unreadable input.
    45	# Tested by evals/tests/validate-suite.bats.
    46	# =============================================================================
    47	set -euo pipefail
    48	export LC_ALL=C
    49	
    50	SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
    51	REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
    52	ROOT="$REPO_ROOT/grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0"
    53	SUITE_FILE="$REPO_ROOT/evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml"
    54	PROMPTS_DIR="${LOA_EVAL_PHASE_PROMPTS_DIR:-$SCRIPT_DIR/lib/phase-prompts}"
    55	SMOKE=false ALLOW_PARTIAL=false
    56	
    57	usage() { sed -n '2,/^# =====.*$/p' "$0" | sed -n '2,45p' | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//' >&2; exit 2; }
    58	die() { echo "validate-suite: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
    59	
    60	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    61	  case "$1" in
    62	    --root) ROOT="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    63	    --smoke) SMOKE=true; shift ;;
    64	    --allow-partial) ALLOW_PARTIAL=true; shift ;;
    65	    --suite-file) SUITE_FILE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    66	    --help|-h) usage ;;
    67	    *) die "unknown option: $1 (see --help)" ;;
    68	  esac
    69	done
    70	[[ -n "$ROOT" && -d "$ROOT" ]] || die "suite root not found: ${ROOT:-<empty>}"
    71	ROOT="$(cd "$ROOT" && pwd)"
    72	[[ -f "$SUITE_FILE" ]] || die "suite file not found: $SUITE_FILE"
    73	for tool in yq jq python3; do command -v "$tool" >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "missing tool: $tool"; done
    74	# eval.yml trust boundary: a literal in-tree path, no variable on the source line
    75	pushd "$SCRIPT_DIR" >/dev/null
    76	# shellcheck source=lib/sandbox-mount.sh
    77	source ./lib/sandbox-mount.sh
    78	popd >/dev/null
    79	
    80	WORK="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/validate-suite.XXXXXX")"
    81	trap 'rm -rf "$WORK"' EXIT
    82	yq -o=json '.' "$SUITE_FILE" > "$WORK/suite.json" 2>/dev/null || die "suite file is not valid YAML: $SUITE_FILE"
    83	
    84	# Collect task directories: tasks/* (counted) and smoke/* (with --smoke).
    85	: > "$WORK/tasks.tsv"
    86	for group in tasks smoke; do
    87	  [[ "$group" == "smoke" && "$SMOKE" != "true" ]] && continue
    88	  [[ -d "$ROOT/$group" ]] || continue
    89	  for d in "$ROOT/$group"/*/; do
    90	    [[ -d "$d" ]] || continue
    91	    d="${d%/}"
    92	    n="$(basename "$d")"
    93	    j="$WORK/$group.$n.json"
    94	    if [[ ! -f "$d/task.yaml" ]]; then
    95	      printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$group" "$n" "$d" "-" >> "$WORK/tasks.tsv"; continue
    96	    fi
    97	    if yq -o=json '.' "$d/task.yaml" > "$j" 2>/dev/null && jq -e 'type == "object"' "$j" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    98	      printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$group" "$n" "$d" "$j" >> "$WORK/tasks.tsv"
    99	    else
   100	      printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$group" "$n" "$d" "!" >> "$WORK/tasks.tsv"
   101	    fi
   102	  done
   103	done
   104	
   105	# Python does the schema, counts, allowlist, manifest, leakage and suite checks;

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# tools/check-manifest-paths.sh — cycle-130 FR-1 (#1267; SDD §5.2, DEC-0368)
     4	#
     5	# CI gate for the System Zone integrity manifest: every path listed in
     6	# `.claude/checksums.json` must be TRACKED (`git ls-files -- .claude`) and
     7	# PRESENT in the working tree. A manifest generated by walking a dirty tree
     8	# (the #1267 class) lists build, cache and runtime artefacts that no fresh
     9	# mount has, so every downstream `check-loa.sh` reports them as Missing.
    10	#
    11	# Offenders are grouped on stderr:
    12	#   untracked  — listed in the manifest, not in `git ls-files`; each carries a
    13	#                DIAGNOSTIC class (first match wins):
    14	#                  __pycache__ | .pytest_cache | node_modules | .run
    15	#                      (a path component of that name)
    16	#                  .pyc   (name ends in .pyc)
    17	#                  .lock  (name ends in .lock)
    18	#                  other
    19	#   missing    — tracked, but absent from the working tree
    20	# The classes label untracked offenders only: a TRACKED path is never flagged
    21	# for its name (a committed `.lock` fixture is legitimate).
    22	#
    23	# Last line on stdout:
    24	#   manifest-paths: N entries, M untracked (class=count, ...), K missing
    25	#
    26	# Usage:
    27	#   tools/check-manifest-paths.sh [--manifest FILE] [--root DIR]
    28	#
    29	# Options:
    30	#   --root DIR       repository work tree (default: the git top level of the
    31	#                    current directory)
    32	#   --manifest FILE  manifest to check (default: ROOT/.claude/checksums.json)
    33	#   -h, --help       this text
    34	#
    35	# Exit codes:
    36	#   0  every manifest path is tracked and present
    37	#   1  at least one untracked or missing path (listed on stderr)
    38	#   2  usage error, ROOT is not a git work tree, or the manifest is absent or
    39	#      not JSON with a `files` object
    40	# =============================================================================
    41	set -euo pipefail
    42	export LC_ALL=C
    43	
    44	usage() { sed -n '/^# Usage:/,/^# =====/p' "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" | sed -e '$d' -e 's/^# \{0,1\}//'; }
    45	die2() { echo "check-manifest-paths: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
    46	
    47	ROOT=""
    48	MANIFEST=""
    49	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    50	  case "$1" in
    51	    --root)
    52	      [[ $# -ge 2 && -n "$2" ]] || die2 "--root requires a directory"
    53	      ROOT="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    54	    --manifest)
    55	      [[ $# -ge 2 && -n "$2" ]] || die2 "--manifest requires a file path"
    56	      MANIFEST="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    57	    -h|--help) usage; exit 0 ;;
    58	    *) die2 "unknown argument: $1 (see --help)" ;;
    59	  esac
    60	done
    61	
    62	if [[ -z "$ROOT" ]]; then
    63	  ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || die2 "not inside a git work tree (use --root DIR)"
    64	fi
    65	[[ -d "$ROOT" ]] || die2 "--root is not a directory: $ROOT"
    66	ROOT="$(cd "$ROOT" && pwd -P)"
    67	[[ "$(git -C "$ROOT" rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree 2>/dev/null || true)" == "true" ]] \
    68	  || die2 "not a git work tree: $ROOT"
    69	[[ -n "$MANIFEST" ]] || MANIFEST="${ROOT}/.claude/checksums.json"
    70	[[ -f "$MANIFEST" ]] || die2 "manifest not found: $MANIFEST"
    71	jq -e '.files | type == "object"' "$MANIFEST" >/dev/null 2>&1 \
    72	  || die2 "manifest is not JSON with a files object: $MANIFEST"
    73	
    74	TMP_DIR="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/check-manifest-paths.XXXXXX")"
    75	cleanup() { rm -rf "$TMP_DIR"; }
    76	trap cleanup EXIT
    77	
    78	# Both lists newline-separated and C-sorted. A path with a newline cannot be
    79	# represented in either list; gen-checksums.sh refuses to emit one.
    80	git -C "$ROOT" ls-files -- .claude | sort -u > "${TMP_DIR}/tracked"
    81	jq -r '.files | keys[]' "$MANIFEST" | sort -u > "${TMP_DIR}/listed"
    82	comm -23 "${TMP_DIR}/listed" "${TMP_DIR}/tracked" > "${TMP_DIR}/untracked"
    83	comm -12 "${TMP_DIR}/listed" "${TMP_DIR}/tracked" > "${TMP_DIR}/both"
    84	
    85	classify() {
    86	  local p="$1"
    87	  if [[ "$p" =~ (^|/)(__pycache__|\.pytest_cache|node_modules|\.run)(/|$) ]]; then
    88	    printf '%s' "${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"
    89	  elif [[ "$p" == *.pyc ]]; then
    90	    printf '.pyc'
    91	  elif [[ "$p" == *.lock ]]; then
    92	    printf '.lock'
    93	  else
    94	    printf 'other'
    95	  fi
    96	}
    97	
    98	# Classified untracked offenders: "<class>\t<path>"
    99	: > "${TMP_DIR}/untracked.cls"
   100	while IFS= read -r p; do
   101	  [[ -n "$p" ]] || continue
   102	  printf '%s\t%s\n' "$(classify "$p")" "$p" >> "${TMP_DIR}/untracked.cls"
   103	done < "${TMP_DIR}/untracked"
   104	
   105	: > "${TMP_DIR}/missing"
   106	while IFS= read -r p; do
   107	  [[ -n "$p" ]] || continue
   108	  [[ -e "${ROOT}/${p}" ]] || printf '%s\n' "$p" >> "${TMP_DIR}/missing"
   109	done < "${TMP_DIR}/both"
   110	
   111	entries=$(wc -l < "${TMP_DIR}/listed" | tr -d ' ')
   112	n_untracked=$(wc -l < "${TMP_DIR}/untracked.cls" | tr -d ' ')
   113	n_missing=$(wc -l < "${TMP_DIR}/missing" | tr -d ' ')
   114	
   115	class_summary=""
   116	if [[ "$n_untracked" -gt 0 ]]; then
   117	  echo "check-manifest-paths: untracked manifest paths (not in git ls-files -- .claude), by class:" >&2
   118	  for cls in __pycache__ .pytest_cache node_modules .run .pyc .lock other; do
   119	    c=$(awk -F'\t' -v c="$cls" '$1 == c' "${TMP_DIR}/untracked.cls" | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
   120	    [[ "$c" -gt 0 ]] || continue
   121	    class_summary="${class_summary:+${class_summary}, }${cls}=${c}"
   122	    echo "  [${cls}] ${c} path(s):" >&2
   123	    awk -F'\t' -v c="$cls" '$1 == c { print "    " $2 }' "${TMP_DIR}/untracked.cls" >&2
   124	  done
   125	fi
   126	if [[ "$n_missing" -gt 0 ]]; then
   127	  echo "check-manifest-paths: tracked manifest paths absent from the working tree:" >&2
   128	  sed 's/^/    /' "${TMP_DIR}/missing" >&2
   129	fi
   130	
   131	echo "manifest-paths: ${entries} entries, ${n_untracked} untracked${class_summary:+ (${class_summary})}, ${n_missing} missing"
   132	if [[ "$n_untracked" -gt 0 || "$n_missing" -gt 0 ]]; then
   133	  echo "check-manifest-paths: FAIL — regenerate with: bash tools/gen-checksums.sh" >&2
   134	  exit 1
   135	fi
   136	exit 0

     1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# tools/fresh-mount-proof.sh — cycle-130 FR-1 (#1267; SDD §5.4, AC-1.3)
     4	#
     5	# Proves that a FRESH downstream submodule mount of this repository passes
     6	# `check-loa.sh` integrity: no Tampered, no Missing (paths the mount does not
     7	# link by design are reported as not-mounted and do not fail).
     8	#
     9	# Steps, all inside a new temp directory (nothing outside it is written):
    10	#   1. upstream/   — a `git clone` of this repository over file://, with a
    11	#                    local branch `fresh-mount-proof` at REF. With --worktree
    12	#                    the source work tree's uncommitted state (tracked edits,
    13	#                    deletions and untracked non-ignored files) is copied in
    14	#                    and committed on that branch, inside the temp clone only.
    15	#   2. downstream/ — `git init`, one commit, then the downstream entry point
    16	#                    `upstream/.claude/scripts/mount-submodule.sh --branch
    17	#                    fresh-mount-proof --ref <sha> --force` with
    18	#                    LOA_UPSTREAM=file://.../upstream (the mount clones the
    19	#                    submodule from there; no network).
    20	#   3. `aleph.enabled: false` is set in downstream/.loa.config.yaml.
    21	#   4. `bash .claude/scripts/check-loa.sh` runs in downstream/; its full output
    22	#      is printed, then a summary line
    23	#        fresh-mount-proof: Tampered=T Missing=M not-mounted=N check-loa-rc=R
    24	#
    25	# Git runs hermetically: GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1,
    26	# a fixed identity, protocol.file.allow=always (needed for a file:// submodule
    27	# on git >= 2.38.1) and core.hooksPath pointed at an empty directory.
    28	#
    29	# Usage:
    30	#   tools/fresh-mount-proof.sh [--ref REF] [--worktree] [--keep] [--tmp DIR]
    31	#
    32	# Options:
    33	#   --ref REF    commit-ish of this repository to mount (default: HEAD of the
    34	#                repository the script lives in)
    35	#   --worktree   mount REF plus the source work tree's uncommitted state
    36	#                (use before the change is committed)
    37	#   --keep       keep the temp directory and print its path
    38	#   --tmp DIR    parent directory for the temp directory (default: $TMPDIR or
    39	#                /tmp)
    40	#   -h, --help   this text
    41	#
    42	# Exit codes:
    43	#   0    check-loa.sh exited 0 on the fresh mount
    44	#   1    check-loa.sh exited non-zero (its output names the failures)
    45	#   2    usage error
    46	#   3    setup failed (clone, overlay, downstream init or the mount itself);
    47	#        the failing step's output is printed
    48	# =============================================================================
    49	set -euo pipefail
    50	export LC_ALL=C
    51	
    52	usage() { sed -n '/^# Usage:/,/^# =====/p' "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" | sed -e '$d' -e 's/^# \{0,1\}//'; }
    53	die2() { echo "fresh-mount-proof: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
    54	die3() { echo "fresh-mount-proof: SETUP FAILED: $*" >&2; exit 3; }
    55	
    56	REF=""
    57	KEEP=0
    58	WORKTREE=0
    59	TMP_PARENT="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}"
    60	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    61	  case "$1" in
    62	    --ref)
    63	      [[ $# -ge 2 && -n "$2" ]] || die2 "--ref requires a commit-ish"
    64	      REF="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    65	    --tmp)
    66	      [[ $# -ge 2 && -n "$2" ]] || die2 "--tmp requires a directory"
    67	      TMP_PARENT="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    68	    --keep) KEEP=1; shift ;;
    69	    --worktree) WORKTREE=1; shift ;;
    70	    -h|--help) usage; exit 0 ;;
    71	    *) die2 "unknown argument: $1 (see --help)" ;;
    72	  esac
    73	done
    74	[[ -d "$TMP_PARENT" ]] || die2 "--tmp is not a directory: $TMP_PARENT"
    75	
    76	SELF_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd -P)"
    77	SRC="$(git -C "$SELF_DIR" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || die2 "script is not inside a git work tree"
    78	[[ -n "$REF" ]] || REF="HEAD"
    79	REF_SHA="$(git -C "$SRC" rev-parse --verify --quiet "${REF}^{commit}")" || die2 "not a commit in $SRC: $REF"
    80	
    81	WORK="$(mktemp -d "${TMP_PARENT%/}/fresh-mount-proof.XXXXXX")"
    82	cleanup() {
    83	  if [[ $KEEP -eq 1 ]]; then
    84	    echo "fresh-mount-proof: kept $WORK" >&2
    85	  else
    86	    rm -rf "$WORK"
    87	  fi
    88	}
    89	trap cleanup EXIT
    90	
    91	# --- hermetic git ---------------------------------------------------------------
    92	mkdir -p "$WORK/no-hooks"
    93	export GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1
    94	export GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=3
    95	export GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=protocol.file.allow GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=always
    96	export GIT_CONFIG_KEY_1=core.hooksPath GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_1="$WORK/no-hooks"
    97	export GIT_CONFIG_KEY_2=init.defaultBranch GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_2=main
    98	export GIT_AUTHOR_NAME="fresh-mount-proof" GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL="fresh-mount-proof@localhost"
    99	export GIT_COMMITTER_NAME="$GIT_AUTHOR_NAME" GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL="$GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL"
   100	unset LOA_ALEPH_ENABLED
   101	
   102	LOG="$WORK/step.log"
   103	run_step() {  # run_step <description> <cmd...>; output to $LOG, printed on failure
   104	  local desc="$1"; shift
   105	  if ! "$@" > "$LOG" 2>&1; then
   106	    cat "$LOG" >&2
   107	    die3 "$desc"
   108	  fi
   109	}
   110	
   111	suffix=""
   112	[[ $WORKTREE -eq 1 ]] && suffix=" + work-tree state"
   113	echo "fresh-mount-proof: source $SRC at ${REF_SHA}${suffix}"
   114	echo "fresh-mount-proof: temp dir $WORK"
   115	
   116	# --- 1. upstream clone ----------------------------------------------------------
